title: Node Load Balancing
summary: Probes the nodes of the active transport engine and switches to the best one for the chosen mode. Nodes are Passwall nodes, WireGuard peers, OpenVPN instances or sing-box/Xray outbounds.

items.title: Select Nodes for Balancing
items.description: Lists the nodes defined in the active engine and stores the ones you pick in /etc/daypass/proxy/balancer/nodes.list.
items.usage_tip: Enter node numbers separated by spaces, for example 1 3 4. Select again after switching engines.

items.title: Set Balancing Mode
items.description: Chooses between round-robin, least-ping, failover and random selection.
items.usage_tip: Failover is the safest choice for unstable links.

items.title: Apply Balancer (probe & switch node)
items.description: Probes every selected node (TCP connect, or ping for UDP nodes), picks one for the mode and makes it the engine's active node.
items.usage_tip: It runs once per Apply; the active node is left unchanged when no selected node answers.

items.title: Disable Balancer
items.description: Clears the saved mode, node list and probe results, and removes the old Passwall balancer section if present.
items.usage_tip: The currently active node stays in use.

items.title: Probe Selected Nodes
items.description: Shows reachability and latency for each selected node without switching.
items.usage_tip: UDP nodes that ignore ping show as unknown rather than down.

items.title: Back
items.description: Returns to the Proxy & Routing Manager.
items.usage_tip: Balancer settings stay as they are.
